podcast.title: Major Label Benchmark
podcast.body: Parlophone is cited as another example of a "great record company" for which a 20,000-pound recording budget would be modest for a professional recording. This context emphasizes that Joy Division's budget for *Unknown Pleasures* was considerable for an independent venture. "o como podía ser la Parlofon."
